title: Sebastian and the Verdict
author: Silas Thornbury
blurb: Emrys Ravensworth, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
